```{r}
#| include: true
source(file.path(root,"scripts","fig/seismicity.R"))
LEGEND <- ""
if (Available) {
  if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.seismicity.ES")
  if (!exists("CAP.same", inherits = FALSE)) CAP.same <- readCaption("fig.seismicity.same.ES")
  LEGEND <- glue::glue(if (key.Mw == key.Rhyp) CAP.same else CAP)
}
```
